Find the first three non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of ln⁡(1+3x2).

a
ln⁡(1+3x2)=−x2+3x4−9x6+⋯
b
ln⁡(1+3x2)=x2−92x4−3x6−⋯
c
ln⁡(1+3x2)=−3x2+32x4+9x6+⋯
d
ln⁡(1+3x2)=3x2−32x4+3x6−⋯
e
ln⁡(1+3x2)=3x2−92x4+9x6−⋯
